meta.name: Scribefloat Design System
meta.product: Scribefloat — local audio transcription for macOS

weightsOmitted.300: too light on dark backgrounds — omitted entirely

meta.tone: instrument-grade. terse, precise, zero hype. reads like terminal output.

casing.cta: Title Case (Stop and Save, Record Again)
casing.never: Title Case for labels or section headers

colors.description: OKLCH-based palette. Dark mode is default. Accents are reserved — each has exactly one semantic job. See rules.colors for usage restrictions.

surface-lowest.role: Primary panel face, modal body, right column

surface-low.role: Cards, note items, waveform bg, dividers

surface-high.role: Input borders, model card borders, hover bg

surface-highest.role: Toggle knob (off), active pill, pressed states

on-surface-dim.role: Secondary labels, captions, waveform idle bars

primary.role: Primary action button only. One per screen.

secondary.role: Secondary CTA outline/text. One per screen max.

error.role: Recording status dot, destructive button, inline error text

green.role: Transient success text or check icon only. Never persistent.

primary.note: Darkened from dark mode for contrast on white

secondary.note: Yellow shifts to olive-amber at this lightness

typography.rule: Geist for prose and UI labels. Geist Mono for anything that reads like an instrument readout — if it would look right on a terminal or piece of equipment, use Mono.
typography.weightRule: No bold. Hierarchy via size, case, and opacity only. Never font-weight 600 or 700.

display-lg.usage: Recording timer only. One instance per screen.

headline-sm.usage: Modal titles, screen-level headers. One per view.

body-md.usage: Transcript body, descriptions, onboarding prose, accordion content.

label-md.usage: Form field labels, accordion titles, button text, inline control labels.

label-sm.usage: Section dividers, metadata captions, status labels.

label-sm-mono.usage: File sizes, model names, hotkey chips, version strings, data labels.

spacing.description: Dense UI. Base unit is p-3 (12px). Use flex/grid with gap — never margin on siblings.

1.usage: Internal icon padding. Gap between dot and label. Chip inner spacing.

2.usage: Icon button padding. Gap between label and value. Within a form field row.

3.usage: Panel section padding. Note card padding. Gap between form fields. Modal body.

4.usage: Panel header horizontal padding. Modal header. Primary CTA footer zone.

6.usage: Onboarding step padding. Between major layout zones (left/right split).

8.usage: Onboarding illustration breathing room. Never inside a Scribe panel.

omitted: anything above 8 inside the Scribe window
rules: Always use flex/grid with gap for sibling spacing — never margin between siblings
p-3 is the base unit inside panels
Keep horizontal padding consistent per zone — p-3 or p-4, never mixed
Max spacing inside Scribe window is p-8

sm.usage: Chips, small tags, status dot containers, inner elements within cards

md.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards, panels, modals — everything else

full.usage: Toggle knob and recording status dot only. Nothing else.

rules: No pill buttons
No rounded modals beyond rounded-md
4px maximum on all interactive elements — this is an instrument, not a consumer app

ambient.usage: PanelShell floating window only. No shadow on cards or modals.

rules: Elevation is communicated by surface lightness steps, not shadow
Only the top-level floating panel uses a shadow
Cards, modals, and inner panels: no shadow

principles: Build every screen in grey first. Add an accent only when it carries a specific meaning.
Each accent color owns exactly one job. Orange = primary action. Red = live/danger. They are not interchangeable.
Max two accents visible simultaneously. Orange + red during recording is the only sanctioned pair.
Yellow, green, blue are for momentary or single-use states — never persistent background tints or borders.
Use opacity variants (white/40, on-surface/60) to dim. Do not tint grey surfaces with accent colors.

primary.job: The one primary action button per screen
use: Primary action button (Stop and Save, Record)

error.job: Live recording state and destructive actions

secondary.job: Secondary CTA when a primary already exists

never: Links or interactive elements outside tabs
Any element that stays visible indefinitely

violations.fix: Use on-surface-dim (oklch 0.60) for idle bars; on-surface at 40% opacity for active bars

violations.bad: Permission cards with persistent green border + tint
violations.fix: Use surface-high border for all permission rows. Show green check icon only.

violations.bad: Multiple yellow secondary buttons on one screen
violations.fix: Demote to ghost (sf-btn-ghost). Reserve yellow outline for the single most important secondary action.

violations.bad: Title input focus underline in orange
violations.fix: Use surface-highest (1px border-bottom) or white/20 outline for focus states.

principles: No bold text in the UI. Hierarchy comes from size, case, and opacity — not weight.
If you reach for bold to add emphasis, add spacing or case instead.
Geist Mono for anything that reads like an instrument readout. Geist for everything else.
300 weight is removed entirely — too light on dark backgrounds.
Uppercase + tracking-stamped (0.05em) is a single visual treatment — always use them together.
Use flex/grid with gap for all sibling spacing — never margin on siblings.
p-3 is the base unit inside panels.
Keep horizontal padding consistent per zone — do not mix p-3 and p-4 within the same panel.
Never use spacing values outside the defined scale (no p-5, p-7, p-9, p-10).

surfaces.elevationModel: Lighter surface = higher elevation (dark mode). Darker surface = higher elevation (light mode). Never use shadow or border weight to indicate elevation.
surfaces.waveform: Use on-surface-dim (0.60) for idle waveform bars — not surface-highest (0.40). On void background, surface-highest has ~2:1 contrast (near invisible). on-surface-dim gives ~3.5:1.
principles: void is never used as a card or container surface — page/window only
Elevation is communicated purely by background lightness — no shadows on inner elements
No colored surface tints (no green/red/orange at low opacity as persistent backgrounds)

button.description: Four variants. Primary is orange-filled. Secondary is yellow-outline. Ghost is transparent. Destructive is red-filled.
rules: Max one primary button per screen
Max one secondary button per screen
If secondary would appear without a primary, use ghost instead
Font: Geist Mono for primary, Geist for all others
Radius: rounded-md (4px) always
No pill or full-round buttons

primary.tw: bg-primary text-on-primary font-mono text-label-sm uppercase tracking-stamped rounded-md px-3 py-1.5
primary.usage: The single most important action on screen

secondary.tw: border border-secondary text-secondary bg-transparent font-sans text-label-md rounded-md px-3 py-1.5
secondary.usage: Second-priority action when a primary already exists on screen

ghost.tw: bg-transparent text-on-surface font-sans text-label-md rounded-md px-3 py-1.5

destructive.tw: bg-error text-on-error font-sans text-label-md rounded-md px-3 py-1.5

iconButton.description: Square button for icons only. Must have aria-label.
rules: Always include aria-label
Never use without an accessible label

toggle.description: On/off switch. Orange track when on, surface-lowest when off. Knob is full-round.

tw.knob: absolute top-1 w-4 h-4 rounded-full transition-[left,right]

input.tw: bg-surface-lowest border border-surface-high rounded-md text-on-surface font-sans text-label-md px-2 py-1.5 outline-none
rules: Focus ring: surface-highest border only — no orange
Placeholder text: text-on-surface-faint
Always pair with a label in label-sm style above
No paused state in yellow — omit dot when paused, show text status instead
No shadow
No colored borders
Border only when needed for separation: border border-surface-high

trigger.tw: w-full flex items-center justify-between p-3 bg-transparent text-on-surface/60 font-sans text-body-md

modal.header: flex items-center justify-between p-4 border-b border-surface-low
rules: Backdrop is black/50 — no blur
Max-width: fit the content, not full-screen
Header uses sf-headline-sm for title
Close button is icon-only ghost variant

tabs.description: Settings modal navigation. Active tab uses tertiary (blue) indicator.
rules: Blue used only for the active tab bottom border — nothing else in the UI uses blue

bars.note: on-surface-dim gives ~3.5:1 contrast on void bg. surface-highest gives ~2:1 — too low.

scribeWindow.description: Primary floating panel. Menu-bar app, no Dock icon.
scribeWindow.header: flex items-center justify-between min-h-[52px] border-b border-surface-low px-4 gap-3 flex-shrink-0 bg-surface-lowest
scribeWindow.rightCol: flex flex-col border-l border-surface-low bg-surface-lowest p-2.5 min-h-0

settingsModal.overlay: fixed inset-0 bg-black/50 flex items-center justify-center
settingsModal.panel: bg-surface-lowest rounded-md w-[520px] max-h-[80vh] flex flex-col shadow-ambient

onboarding.description: First-run 4-step wizard. Full panel, no close button.
onboarding.container: flex flex-col items-center justify-center h-full p-6 gap-6 bg-surface-lowest

dictateBar.description: Compact menu-bar overlay for quick dictation.
dictateBar.container: bg-surface-lowest rounded-md shadow-ambient px-3 py-2 flex items-center gap-3

rules: No exclamation marks
No 'we' or 'our'
Labels are ALL CAPS with letter-spacing
Prose is sentence case
CTAs are Title Case (Stop and Save, Record Again)
Ellipsis for in-progress states (Starting…), not spinner copy
Error messages: lowercase, inline, no icon
